title: Point CAD
description: Embeddable parametric 3D point-structure sketcher: labeled points driven by named variables and distance/angle constraints, solved on demand with a pluggable Gauss-Newton solver. Worlds can be built in the 3D viewport or written in PCS, a tiny declarative script language that doubles as the .pcad file format. Ships with Theme CAD, a constraint-based colour theme designer built on the same core.
